subject: SparkOnboarding: promo sweetener, stacking rules, and tax/invoice notes
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@seedvault.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Spark onboarding — promo package & pricing framework

Samir,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the demo. As discussed, attached is an initial promo proposal for SeedVault's three-month pilot. High-level: 100k complimentary generation tokens (non-transferable), standard rate card for embeddings, and a staged discount if you convert to Reserved/Dedicated within 120 days. See details in the attached promo-pricing-v1.pdf.

A couple of points we wanted to flag up front so procurement can prepare:
- Stacking: sponsor or partner credits may not stack with our onboarding promo beyond the first 2 offers; we can make exceptions with approvals.
- Billing path: promo credits are consumed first; overages invoice monthly at net rates listed.
- Data/access: for the pilot we recommend hosted API with an option to move to Dedicated — conversion mechanics are in the SOW.

Next steps: can you confirm (1) a primary billing contact and (2) whether you have a VAT ID or W-9 on file (we'll need it for invoicing)? If you want, we can tighten the offer to include a one-time onboarding credit for paid customers who convert within 60 days — that would require an executive approval.

I've cc'd Logan and Marissa to handle the ops and legal handoff.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: promo-pricing-v1.pdf (one-page summary)

From: Samir Patel <samir@seedvault.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spark onboarding — promo package & pricing framework

Ben — thanks for the note and the quick turn. SeedVault is excited to run a pilot. A few clarifying questions from our side before we push to procurement/legal:

1) Stacking — we run on a mix of sponsor credits (from our accelerator partner) and internal pilot budgets. Can you confirm the exact stacking rule (e.g., is the onboarding promo mutually exclusive with any sponsor credit, or just limited stacking when both are Redwood-origin)? That affects our accounting.

2) Volume discounts — the proposal references a staged discount post-conversion. Can you share the expected discount bands (e.g., 10% at $X/month committed, 20% at $Y/month)? We need numbers to model our runway.

3) Tax & invoice — we operate from the EU (Ireland). Will Redwood issue invoices with VAT handling, or do we need to provide a VAT ID and handle reverse charge?

4) SOW & terms — curious if you can send a redline-friendly SOW so our legal team can quickly mark up any procurement constraints.

If possible, please include an example invoice flow so our finance team can sign off. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call next week if that's easier.

Best,
Samir
CEO, SeedVault
samir@seedvault.ai

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@seedvault.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spark onboarding — promo package & pricing framework

Samir — glad to see interest and thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers and an updated path forward below. I've also attached a tightened offer (promo-pricing-v2.pdf) and a redline-friendly SOW draft (SOW-SeedVault-draft.docx).

Stacking: we try to keep stacking simple for accounting. The rule for this offer is: onboarding promo (100k gen tokens) is exclusive of any other Redwood-origin promos. Sponsor credits from third parties (accelerator partners) are allowed to be applied to the same account, but we cannot double-credit Redwood-origin onboarding promos with other internal Redwood promotions. If your sponsor credit is administered outside of Redwood (i.e., direct from the accelerator), you can use both; if it's a Redwood-managed sponsor allocation, we need an approval.

Volume discounts (post-conversion): the v2 attachment outlines explicit bands — 10% at $10k/mo committed (3mo min), 18% at $25k/mo, and 25% for $50k+/mo. Those are headline bands; we can carve a bespoke path for a multi-quarter commit with legal signoff.

Tax / Invoicing: since you're EU-based, please provide a VAT ID and we will issue invoices net of VAT where reverse-charge applies. For entities in Ireland we will follow standard cross-border VAT handling; our finance team will itemize on the invoice once we have your VAT ID and billing address. If you prefer a local entity invoice, we can discuss.

SOW & Procurement workflow: the SOW draft includes a conversion trigger clause (if you convert to Dedicated within 120 days, onboarding credit is re-applied as a one-time conversion credit up to $3k prorated). We will invoice monthly for any overages; promo credits consume first. To expedite procurement, please have your billing contact send a PO referencing DEAL-5412 and attach VAT ID or W-9 as appropriate.

Operational guardrails: we will enforce a soft spike guard at 150% of historical pilot daily QPS to protect your pilot from runaway charges; if you expect bursty usage we can pre-authorize a higher cap. Also note that onboarding credits expire 90 days after issue if not consumed.

Next steps I suggest:
- Samir: confirm billing contact + VAT ID (or W-9)
- Ben: share the v2 attachment and SOW in DocSend (done)
- Marissa & Irene: can you review the conversion credit language and approve the 25% band for $50k+/mo?

Samir, happy to hop on a 20-min call Tuesday to walk finance/legal through the invoice example and the SOW redlines. If everything looks good we'll issue a PO-ready one-page cover letter your procurement can sign.

Warmly,
Logan
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: promo-pricing-v2.pdf (2 pages), SOW-SeedVault-draft.docx (redline-friendly)
